name: Oshi Hikaru
source:
Despite her young age, she works as the president of a farming equipment store called "Oshi's Agricultural Machinery".

She's married to her husband, but still doesn't have any kids.

She lives together with the protagonist, and often gives him various advice.

[Translated from the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160401085609/http://www.sakuramint.net/tsugiteras/tsugi_chara.htm]official website[/url]]
